factor_name: Volatility-normalized multi-horizon reversal with disagreement boost

calculation.description: Ranks assets by a volatility-normalized contrarian blend of lagged 5-session and 20-session returns. When short- and medium-horizon returns disagree, the signal receives a modest boost to capture short-term overshoot relative to the broader move. All inputs are lagged by one completed session.

validation.regime_notes: Validated across the available synthetic cross-asset benchmark and multiple historical regimes; uncertainty is interpreted conservatively because the cross-section has 15 instruments.
